title: Antam Posts 240% Net Profit Surge in H1 2025, Nickel Segment Drives Record Growth
body: PT Antam’s first‑half 2025 net profit jumped 240% to Rp5.14 trillion, largely thanks to a 240% rise in nickel earnings (Rp3.53 trillion) and a 125% increase in nickel sales to Rp7.87 trillion, with ore production up 117% to 9.10 Mt and sales volume up 144% to 8.20 Mt, setting a quarterly record. Meanwhile gold sales surged 163% to Rp49.54 trillion, and the company advanced its ESG agenda with a 2030 decarbonization roadmap, 75% land rehabilitation, and a new SGAR alumina smelter project entering commissioning.

title: Indonesia Issues New Mining Regulation to Expand Access for SMEs, Cooperatives, and Religious Organizations
body: The government issued PP 39/2025, a second amendment to PP 96/2021, to accelerate inclusion of SMEs, cooperatives, and religious organizations in mining and downstream activities, allowing priority allocation of up to 2,500 ha for SMEs and 25,000 ha for larger entities. The regulation also permits use of by‑product radioactive minerals as new energy sources, prioritizes domestic demand and value‑added processing, and revises license renewal terms to extend up to 10 years for integrated operations, with a one‑year grace period for expired permits.
